heroSummary: In Lake Washington School District, students in grades 1–12 start school on Monday, August 31, 2026. Kindergarten begins Thursday, September 3, after three days of Kindergarten Family Connections. Winter Break is December 21–January 1, Spring Break is April 12–16, and the final K–12 student day is a half day on Wednesday, June 16, 2027.

calendarNotes: The LWSD 2026–27 calendar separates grades 1–12, kindergarten, preschool, and SNAPS dates. Kindergarten Family Connections happen before the first kindergarten day. LEAP days include five planning days before school starts and three no-school Fridays during the student year. Wednesday early release begins September 9. School closure make-up days may extend the practical end of the school year.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for LWSD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Students in grades 1–12 start August 31, while kindergarten begins September 3 after Kindergarten Family Connections.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for LWSD in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break for LWSD in 2027?

calendarFaqs.a: LEAP stands for Learning Enhancement Academic Planning. LWSD schedules five LEAP days before students return in August, plus three no-school LEAP Fridays during the student year: October 16, March 12, and May 28.

calendarFaqs.q: Does LWSD have Wednesday early release?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Beginning September 9, elementary students are released 90 minutes early and secondary students are released 105 minutes early on Wednesdays.

calendarFaqs.q: Can the last day of school change?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled final K–12 student day is June 16. If closures require additional instructional days, LWSD may use June 1, June 17, or June 21–23 as makeup days.

customSections.label: What LWSD Families Should Know
customSections.content: A few dates apply differently to kindergarten, preschool, SNAPS, and the district’s LEAP and early-release schedules.

groups.label: Kindergarten begins three days after grades 1–12
items: Kindergarten Family Connections take place August 31–September 2, and kindergarten begins September 3.

groups.label: LWSD lists two types of LEAP dates
items: LWSD schedules five LEAP days before the student year begins, from August 24–28.
During the school year, students also have three no-school LEAP Fridays: October 16, March 12, and May 28.

groups.label: Preschool and SNAPS follow their own schedules
items: Preschool runs from September 8 through June 10.
SNAPS begins September 15 and ends June 4.

groups.label: Wednesday early release starts September 9
items: Elementary students are released 90 minutes early, while secondary students are released 105 minutes early.
The scheduled final K–12 day, June 16, is also a half day. LWSD may use June 1, June 17, or June 21–23 if closures extend the school year.
